title: A guide's words, not its looks
statement: An on-screen guide adds little by its presence or look, least for older learners, so spend the effort on what it says, in a conversational register.
example: A review of social-cue principles gave conversational style a median effect of d = 1.3, against d = 0.2 for showing the speaker's image.
detail: The Grade 9 research brief cites a meta-analysis of 43 studies (N = 3,088) in which pedagogical agents had a small overall effect (g = .19), g = .56 in grades 4–7 against g = .12 in post-secondary studies, and g = .00 for static agents, and a second meta-analysis in which 2D agents scored g+ = 0.38 and 3D agents g+ = 0.11. By contrast, a review of social-cue principles gave showing the speaker's image a median d = 0.2 over nine mixed tests, conversational style a median d = 1.3 and a human voice a median d = 0.8. The brief concludes that the agent cannot carry the design on its own and keeps the conversational 'you / we' register, and the Grade 9 strategy shrinks its guide to a small monogram.
against: No high-school studies appear in the age comparison, and the meta-analysis itself suggests novelty may explain part of the school-age effect; the 2D and 3D figures and the social-cue medians were read from abstracts, without the age moderators (`othello-course-renderer-draft/repo/docs/design/grade-9/research/learners-voice-guide.md`, lines 49, 60 and 65). No study has tested whether a cartoon guide costs credibility with 14-year-olds.

evidence.quote: A meta-analysis of 43 studies (N = 3,088) found a small overall effect (g = .19).
Studies in grades 4–7 showed g = .56; post-secondary studies showed g = .12.
The agent cannot carry the design on its own.
2D agents scored g+ = 0.38 and 3D agents g+ = 0.11.
Nine tests gave mixed results, with a median d = 0.2.
By contrast, the personalization principle (conversational style) had a median d = 1.3, and the voice principle (human voice) a median d = 0.8.
Keep the conversational "you / we" register, because that is where the large effect is.
The guide's words matter far more than its face, and narrating text to fluent readers mostly does not help.
